amenities-simple.title: Amenities Simple
amenities-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the amenities of a stay or a venue as short names: muted rows in three or two columns, or outlined pills in a wrapping row.

article-lead.title: Article Lead
article-lead.description: The head of an article: the heading, the lead paragraph and the byline (the portrait, the author, the date) under a wide cover, or beside it.

article-simple.title: Article Simple
article-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the sections of a text (a subheading and its paragraph): one reading column, or two columns under a centred head.

cases-simple.title: Cases Simple
cases-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the case studies (a picture, the client, the title as a link, the result in one line): on cards in three or two columns, or rows with the picture at the start.

chapters-simple.title: Chapters Simple
chapters-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the chapters (a picture, a label, the title, a paragraph): rows with the picture at the side, or a pair with the picture under the copy.

choice-links.title: Choice Links
choice-links.description: The heading, one paragraph and the options (sizes, versions) as outline links: a wrapping row, or a grid of four.

collections-simple.title: Collections Simple
collections-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the collections (a picture and the name as one link) in four or two columns.

compare-simple.title: Compare Simple
compare-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and two options side by side: their names in a header row, then a row per feature with the value of each.

compose.title: Compose
compose.description: Barrel of the composed primitives (compose/index), imported by components and blocks

contacts-simple.title: Contacts Simple
contacts-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the teams to reach on cards (an icon, the name, a line, an action): in three or two columns, or rows with the icon at the side.

course-outline.title: Course Outline
course-outline.description: The heading, one paragraph and the modules in order (a label, the title, a line, the length): rows in a narrow column, or two columns of cards.

cta-simple.title: Cta Simple
cta-simple.description: One band: a badge when set, the heading, one paragraph and up to two buttons; centred or at the start, or the buttons at the end; on a muted or an outlined surface.

delivery-simple.title: Delivery Simple
delivery-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the delivery zones (the area, the time, the minimum order, the price): card rows with the price at the end, or cards in three columns.

digital-simple.title: Digital Simple
digital-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the digital goods (the format as a pill, the name as a link, a line, the price): on cards in three columns, or rows with the price at the end.

error-simple.title: Error Simple
error-simple.description: A page for something that went wrong: the code, the heading, one paragraph and one action back; centred or at the start.

event-intro.title: Event Intro
event-intro.description: The first screen of an event: a badge, the name as a large heading, one paragraph, the date and the place, and one action; centred or at the start.

faq-simple.title: Faq Simple
faq-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the questions with their answers as a list, each under a rule, in two columns or one.

feature-showcase-simple.title: Feature Showcase Simple
feature-showcase-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the key points as a list beside one picture (at the end or the start), or the head over a wide picture with the points in three columns under it.

features-simple.title: Features Simple
features-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the features as a list (an icon disc, a title, a line): in columns under the heading or beside it, the icon on top or at the side.

figure-simple.title: Figure Simple
figure-simple.description: One large picture with its caption (a title, a line, the credit): wide with the caption under it, or the caption at the side.

footer-simple.title: Footer Simple
footer-simple.description: The brand and one line beside the links (a row or a grid of columns), or everything centred; the copyright line under them.

gallery-hero.title: Gallery Hero
gallery-hero.description: The heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions beside three or four photos: at the end, at the start, or in a row under the copy.

guarantees-simple.title: Guarantees Simple
guarantees-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the promises (delivery, quality, returns), each a short title and a line: side by side on one muted band, or on cards, in four or three columns.

header-simple.title: Header Simple
header-simple.description: The brand as the link home, the navigation links and one action in a bar: the links in the middle, at the end beside the action, or centred under the brand. No menu button: the links wrap on a narrow screen.

hero-simple.title: Hero Simple
hero-simple.description: A badge, the heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary), with one picture at the end, at the start (landscape or portrait), on top or at the bottom.

hours-simple.title: Hours Simple
hours-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph, the address (a link to the map), the phone and the opening hours by day: side by side or in one narrow column, plain or on cards.

intro-simple.title: Intro Simple
intro-simple.description: Text only: a badge, a large heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary), centred or at the start, in the middle of the section or low in a tall one.

locations-simple.title: Locations Simple
locations-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the offices (the name, the address) in two columns beside one picture, at the start or the end.

logos-simple.title: Logos Simple
logos-simple.description: A short heading over the logos as a list: a wrapping row or a grid of cards.

menu-simple.title: Menu Simple
menu-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the dishes (a picture, a badge when set, the name, the weight, a line, the price): on cards in three, two or four columns, or menu rows with the price at the end.

offers-simple.title: Offers Simple
offers-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and two or three offers on cards, each with a title, a line and an action.

photos-simple.title: Photos Simple
photos-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the photos as a list in two, three or four columns.

pricing-simple.title: Pricing Simple
pricing-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the plans on cards (the name, a badge on the highlighted plan, a line, the price, an action): in three or two columns, or one row each.

product-reviews.title: Product Reviews
product-reviews.description: The heading, one paragraph and the reviews on cards (the rating, the words, the reviewer with the portrait): in three or two columns, or one under the other.

product-simple.title: Product Simple
product-simple.description: One product: the main picture and thumbnails beside the name, the price, one paragraph and the action; the pictures at the start, at the end or above.

products-simple.title: Products Simple
products-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the products (a picture, the name as a link, the price): in three or four columns, or rows with the picture at the side.

profile-intro.title: Profile Intro
profile-intro.description: A person: the name, the role, one paragraph and the links beside the portrait (at the end or the start), or under a round portrait.

promo-simple.title: Promo Simple
promo-simple.description: One offer: the discount as a badge, the heading, the deadline as text, one paragraph, a promo code when set and one button, beside a picture at the end or at the start, or under a wide one.

pull-quote-simple.title: Pull Quote Simple
pull-quote-simple.description: The words of a quote in large type with the author, a role line and the source under them: a bar at the side, or centred.

purchase-simple.title: Purchase Simple
purchase-simple.description: On a card surface: the heading and one paragraph beside the price, the action and a note; or all centred.

rating-simple.title: Rating Simple
rating-simple.description: The score, what it is and the source as a link: one bar on a card surface, or centred.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Recipes (Tailwind classes per variant/size/state) of the composed primitives

rooms-simple.title: Rooms Simple
rooms-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the rooms (a picture, the name as a link, the guests, a line, the price a night): on cards in three or two columns, or rows with the picture at the start.

services-simple.title: Services Simple
services-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the services (the name as a link, a line, the starting price): on cards in three or two columns, or rows with the price at the end.

specs-simple.title: Specs Simple
specs-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the specifications as name and value rows on a muted surface, in one narrow column or two columns.

split-simple.title: Split Simple
split-simple.description: Two halves: the heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary) beside one picture that fills its half to the edge of the screen.

stats-simple.title: Stats Simple
stats-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the figures as a list (a large value, a label, a note), in two, three or four columns, plain or on cards.

steps-simple.title: Steps Simple
steps-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the steps as an ordered list (a label, a title, a line), in a row of three or four, or one under the other.

store-policies.title: Store Policies
store-policies.description: The heading, one paragraph and the policies (payment, delivery, returns), each with an icon, a title and a line: on cards in columns, or rows.

stories-simple.title: Stories Simple
stories-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the stories as a list (a cover, the title as a link, a line): cards in two or three columns, or compact rows on a card surface.

team-simple.title: Team Simple
team-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the people as a list: a portrait, the name and the role, in two, three or four columns, plain or on cards.

testimonials-simple.title: Testimonials Simple
testimonials-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the quotes as a list (the words, a portrait, the name and the role): on cards in two or three columns, in rows with the portrait at the side, or centred.

timeline-simple.title: Timeline Simple
timeline-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the steps of a process or a history (the date or the stage, a title, a line) as an ordered list: one column of muted steps, or side by side in two or four columns.

topics-simple.title: Topics Simple
topics-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the rubrics of a blog on cards (a label, the title as a link, a line): in two or three columns, or one under the other.
